title: How beauty companies like Qoves are commercializing facial-analysis algorithms that evaluate geometric proportions, balding, and more to prescribe treatments (Alice Lassman/Bloomberg)
summary: Alice Lassman / Bloomberg: How beauty companies like Qoves are commercializing facial-analysis algorithms that evaluate geometric proportions, balding, and more to prescribe treatments — AI beauty tools can measure your jawline, grade your “harmony” and prescribe treatments for improving your face. Does any of it work?
